name: halofire-gateway-head-truth-runtime-repair-20260716
goal: Restore the HaloFire gateway test and runtime import path by replacing its nonexistent external head-count summary dependency with a typed, fail-closed adapter to the repository-owned sealed HaloFire CAD truth database.
exit_criteria: the gateway imports without core.hal.halofire_v2 or another missing external package
head-count truth reads the repository-owned truth DB lazily and never invents an expected count when a sealed record is absent
missing truth returns an explicit Head count truth mismatch warning instead of suppressing the condition
matching truth returns no warning and mismatching truth reports expected, actual, delta, and sealed truth project identity
gateway and CAD tests collect and pass, the 18080 gateway health route starts, and no existing portal warning or signed-download behavior regresses
formal truth-state partition, rulebook, loop guard, and brain postflight pass
verification_gates: strict typed result shape for match, mismatch, truth-unavailable, and truth-source-unavailable states
sealed truth lookup uses exact identity plus explicitly sourced 1881 aliases only
adversarial missing record, missing expected head count, invalid actual count, matching count, and mismatching count tests
existing gateway portal bundle and warning tests
combined HaloFire CAD and gateway pytest suite
live local gateway health smoke on port 18080
